product_launches.description: Vega Health launched five clinically validated AI models from Parkland Center for Clinical Innovation on the Vega Health Marketplace, making them commercially available to health systems nationwide.

overview_description.description: Vega Health connects health systems with vetted artificial intelligence tools through a platform that supports discovery, evaluation, and deployment. The product integrates vendor information, governance workflows, and risk assessments to help organizations compare solutions for clinical and operational use cases. Capabilities include validation frameworks, performance monitoring, and bias and safety reviews to support accountable AI adoption. Implementation services use co-design with clinicians and administrators to align models to workflow, integrate with existing systems, and measure outcomes. The company also offers support for procurement, contracting, and lifecycle management of AI applications across the enterprise.
